comment: Every entry point under scripts/e2e/, in one of two lists, read by .github/workflows/e2e.yaml.
`hosted` is the set a GitHub-hosted runner can run: each row says what the job must give that
script, and `why_hosted` is a note on why a hosted runner can run it, read by no job. `elsewhere`
is every other script, each with the `needs` its own header states; e2e.yaml refuses one by
name with that text, and the refusal is a failed job. Both lists together must name every
scripts/e2e/*.sh of the tree, and e2e.yaml's select job fails when one is missing or extra.
`apt` is what the job installs for that script alone, `bun` whether it needs bun and this
repository's node_modules, `evidence_variable` the environment variable the script reads for
its evidence directory (empty where it takes none and keeps its work directory instead), and
`timeout_minutes` the job's limit, measured from the script's header with headroom.

hosted.why_hosted: DATABASE_URL is required and must name a loopback host; its prerequisite loop takes go, bun, curl, psql and openssl, and it starts no container

The daemon refuses to start without tmux on PATH, and CI's tmux is the runner's apt binary; with LEGION_E2E_PG_DSN set the script starts no container of its own, which is how ci.yaml's daemon-go job already runs it
DATABASE_URL is required and must name a loopback host; its prerequisite loop takes go, bun, curl, psql and openssl, and it starts no container

elsewhere.needs: a throwaway kind cluster with gVisor on an amd64 Linux host, with docker, go, kubectl, curl, zstd, a tar that supports --zstd and kind, and a worker image by digest (LEGION_E2E_IMAGE)
a real cluster (LEGION_E2E_RUNTIME_CONTEXT and a worker image by digest), a devbox daemon, a real Claude Code and Oh My Pi on a model route, and the smoke repository

ci.yaml's agent-harness job, which runs it in its tmux-scripts part: tmux, the pinned Oh My Pi (LEGION_TEST_OMP), Claude Code (LEGION_TEST_CLAUDE) and a loopback PostgreSQL (LEGION_TEST_PG_DSN); it starts its own NATS, listener, model stand-in and legion daemon

a throwaway kind cluster with gVisor on an amd64 Linux host, with docker, go, kubectl, curl, zstd, a tar that supports --zstd and kind, and a worker image by digest (LEGION_E2E_IMAGE)

ci.yaml's agent-harness job, which runs it in its session-settings part: the pinned Oh My Pi (LEGION_TEST_OMP), Playwright's Chromium in packages/dispatch and a loopback PostgreSQL with pgvector (LEGION_TEST_PG_DSN); it starts its own model stand-in, NATS, listener and Dispatch

ci.yaml's agent-harness job, which runs it in its session-scripts part: tmux, the pinned Oh My Pi (LEGION_TEST_OMP), Playwright's Chromium in packages/dispatch and a loopback PostgreSQL with pgvector (LEGION_TEST_PG_DSN); it starts its own model stand-in, NATS, listener and Dispatch

ci.yaml's agent-harness job, which runs it in its session-scripts part: the pinned Oh My Pi (LEGION_TEST_OMP), Claude Code (LEGION_TEST_CLAUDE), socat 1.8.0 or later and a loopback PostgreSQL with pgvector (LEGION_TEST_PG_DSN); it starts its own model stand-in, NATS, listeners and Dispatch

a Legion pod: its own model route for both agent runtimes (LEGION_E2E_MODEL_BASE_URL, LEGION_E2E_MODEL_KEY_FILE, LEGION_E2E_MODEL_ID and LEGION_E2E_CLAUDE_MODEL), the worker image's Oh My Pi and Claude Code pin, and a loopback PostgreSQL with pgvector (ENVOY_SESSION_STATES_PG_DSN); it starts its own NATS, listeners and Dispatch

a pod whose projected Kubernetes credential may create a Job (kubectl -n <namespace> auth can-i create jobs answers yes), the worker image digest to prove (--image, from the Worker Image run's Record digest step) and the deployment's compute class (--node-selector), with the base branch's digest as the negative control (--control); it starts one Job of that image and nothing of its own

the worker image and the Job leak-guard-image-job.sh creates: it is that proof's probe, not a proof of its own, and the harness writes it into the Job's command because a Job holds no checkout to read it from; it runs inside the image against a scratch repository on the Job's emptyDir and judges nothing a runner could give it

a host that reaches a model: a real Oh My Pi on a model route (LEGION_OMP_PATH) for one headless session per arm, a loopback PostgreSQL it creates a database of its own on (LEGION_TEST_PG_DSN), and jj, git, go, bun, psql, curl, the dispatch CLI, gh, python3 and openssl, each of which it refuses to start without: jj and git read the control's commit and extract its daemon module, go and bun run the daemon's prompt composer, gh is the one the composer is told, and psql, curl, python3 and openssl make and reach the e2e Dispatch server it starts

the pinned Oh My Pi every pane runs (LEGION_OMP_PATH, an absolute executable, which a GitHub-hosted runner has none of), go, which it builds its own natsd with, bun with this repository's node_modules, and about fifteen minutes of wall clock, which is longer than any job of ci.yaml holds

a throwaway kind cluster with gVisor on an amd64 Linux host, an NFS server in that cluster, with docker, go, kubectl, curl, zstd, a tar that supports --zstd and kind, and a worker image by digest (LEGION_E2E_IMAGE)

ci.yaml's agent-harness job, which runs it in its tmux-scripts part: tmux, socat, the pinned Oh My Pi (LEGION_TEST_OMP) and a loopback PostgreSQL (LEGION_TEST_PG_DSN); it starts its own NATS, listener, model stand-in and legion daemons
a real cluster from the devbox: LEGION_E2E_PLATFORM, LEGION_E2E_POD_REACHABILITY and LEGION_E2E_MODEL_ROUTE, the daemon's restricted identity, and a worker image by digest
the production cluster from the devbox, against production Dispatch, the production Envoy listener and production NATS, with real agents in the smoke repository

a deployed Dispatch and the operator's own credential: the dispatch command on PATH, run in the operator's own shell with its session (DISPATCH_HOST and DISPATCH_SESSION_ID) and the deployed Dispatch and token its envoy.json or DISPATCH_URL and DISPATCH_TOKEN name, and the key of one issue a deployed Legion ran to done after the release that records each step; it reads that issue's step records and starts nothing
a projected service-account token the staging EKS cluster minted, and its own Postgres and NATS containers
